title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
slides: Your favorite podcast is invisible to AI. Why?
Audio lacks text, so search engines can't index it.
Radar's transcription unlocks every spoken word automatically.
Now AI agents can quote podcasts in their answers.
Ask an agent for podcast insights today. Test it.
thread_text:
1. Your podcast is invisible.

Search engines can't read audio, so your episodes never surface in AI answers. That's a blind spot you didn't know you had.

2. The fix? Transcription.

Radar automatically converts every spoken word into text, making your content searchable and quotable by AI agents.

3. Now AI can quote you.

Once transcribed, your podcast becomes a source. AI agents can pull exact insights and cite them in responses.

4. The ripple effect.

Your reach extends beyond listeners. Your ideas show up in AI-generated answers, reaching people who never hit play.

5. Test it today.

Ask an AI agent for insights from your favorite podcast. If it can't, you know what to do.

instagram.caption:
Your favorite podcast isn’t showing up in AI answers—because search engines can’t read audio. 🎙️

Radar’s transcription now turns every spoken episode into searchable text automatically. That means AI agents can quote your exact words in their responses—not just vaguely reference “a podcast said something.” 📝

For creators, this changes the game: your back catalog becomes a source AI pulls from, reaching people who never press play. Your ideas start working for you outside the feed. 🔁

So—ask an AI agent for insights from your own show right now. If it draws a blank, you’ve found your blind spot. When will you make that test? 🧪
